name: MCP Ads Developer API
description: Connect your customers' ad, analytics and social accounts and run 3,000+ marketing tools on them: Meta, Google Ads, GA4, Search Console, Tag Manager, Merchant Center, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, Microsoft, Snapchat and WordPress. Create a profile per customer, send them a connect link, then call tools with X-Profile-Id. The same key and header work over MCP at /mcp-slim.
